Якщо said / told у минулому, дієслово в: If said / told is in the past, the verb in the reported part moves one step back: is → was, will → would. Pronouns change too: I → he / she, my → his / her.
Після said / told у минулому час відступ: After said / told in the past, the tense moves one step back. If we use says (now), there is no backshift: Lily says she is tired. Table: direct speech, reported speech, example.
